title: Efficient Numerical Schemes for a Two-Phase Hydrodynamical Model of Active Liquid Crystals and Solids
summary: We propose several linear, fully decoupled numerical schemes with first- and second-order temporal accuracy for a novel Q-tensor-based two-phase hydrodynamic model describing the coupling of active nematic liquid crystal solutions with isotropic solid substrates. The model is derived from the generalized Onsager principle and includes nontrivial terms that contribute zero to the total free-energy dissipation.
